official_measurement_examples: statutory metric measures biodiversity value not planning acceptability
10 percent BNG applies where mandatory subject to exemptions
from 6 Aug 2026 applications on sites 0.2ha or below become exempt subject to stated exceptions
NSIP BNG starts 2 Nov 2026 not before
gain-site registration is not allocation to a development
off-site allocation is not planning permission
statutory credits are last resort not a land right
BNG status does not establish ownership or development yield
core_rules: metric output is not planning permission
BNG requirement is subject to current exemptions
future effective date is not current law before commencement
gain site registration is not allocation
credits are not habitat delivery proof
10 percent is biodiversity-unit outcome not site area uplift
BNG does not replace protected species law
BNG does not prove infrastructure capacity
metric version and date must be retained
off-site gain must be legally secured
habitat management duration must be evidenced
no parcel BNG clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
